subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should this PR's explicit `lockProofDecision` / `unlockProofDecision` pair be accepted as the permanent synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation versus canonical proof?
rationale: The patch appears behavior-preserving and fixes the Swift 6.2 actor-isolation closure capture, but the lock boundary decides whether a canceled queued chat message is confirmed as delivered or removed locally.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after owner review confirms the manual lock/defer shape preserves proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, cancellation bookkeeping, and outbox notification ordering.

options.title: Tighten Lock Scope First
options.body: Ask for a narrower local scope that releases the proof lock immediately after the final proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache removal while still avoiding the actor-isolated closure capture.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after owner review confirms the manual lock/defer shape preserves proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, cancellation bookkeeping, and outbox notification ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is the live assignee and the history route for the proof hub and cancellation code being changed.
